answer: Every new identity escrows a bond that stays frozen for four epochs, and clones tracing to one funding wallet pay a doubling rate. One violet account locks 30 POA; its second clone locks 60, its third 120. Ten clones lock 30 x (2^10 - 1) = 30,690 POA. A marble decoy task on a zephyr schedule slashes the whole cluster, so one failed clone forfeits all 30,690.
